reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Dispute tickets roughly doubled from ~600/month (Jun-Jul 2026) to ~1180-1260/month (Aug-Sep 2026) (E-04), and 59% of disputed bills (1785 of 3025) are tied to ACTUAL, non-estimated meter reads rather than estimate substitutions (E-03). This indicates a billing import/calculation defect producing incorrect bills for actual-read accounts - not estimate-substitution from field-read or AMI shortfalls - is the dominant mechanism driving the surge (H-ACTUAL-READ-BILLING-ERROR).
reasoning_quality_informational.v2_root_problem: Dispute ticket volume roughly doubled from ~600/month (Jun-Jul 2026) to ~1180-1260/month (Aug-Sep 2026) (E-04). For a 1240-account bucket matching the ESTIMATED-read share of disputed bills (E-03, as revised in ER-1), this is driven by billing import validation rule BV-17 (deployed 2026-08-01), which compares raw AMI register values directly against m3-denominated 12-month consumption history with no unit scaling (E-13); because firmware v4.2 meters (rolled out June 2026) report register values in units of 0.1 m3 rather than m3 (E-14), their legitimate reads appear roughly 10x true consumption and are misflagged and rejected by billing import as REJECTED_HIGH_CONSUMPTION (1184 of 1240 affected reads, E-12), forcing estimate substitution and producing incorrect bills; the cause of the remaining 1785 ACTUAL-read disputed bills is not yet established by this mechanism.
reasoning_quality_informational.ideal_final_problem: BV-17 validation rejects valid firmware-v4.2 AMI reads (unit-scale mismatch on H-MDMS-BILL) and substitutes estimates.
